description: Search every schedule of an action or state machine (the CheckBehavior RPC, the REPL's %check-property/%check-diverge settings about %action/%state): a property false at a stable state, a deadlock, a failure or a feature whose final value the schedule decides is witnessed and replayed. `verdict` is holds, fails or undecided; `violations`, `divergences` and `finals` carry each witness as its replay schedule, draws and choices, and the witness file when asked for. With checkInput or checkAssume the symbolic engine answers with `claim`, the inputs it ranged over and its witnesses. Bounded by checkDepth, checkStates and checkTimeout. The result is the CheckBehaviorResponse as protojson writes it.

actionSymbolId.description: qualified name of the action definition or usage to check; give this or stateMachineSymbolId

checkAssume.description: constraints or requirements the symbolic engine assumes (-check-assume)

checkDepth.description: moves one schedule may make; 0 is the engine's default (-check-depth)

checkDiverge.description: features whose final value the schedule may decide (-check-diverge); the action's own bare, a node's as node.pin, the performer's as this.<name>

checkInput.description: inputs left free for the symbolic engine to range over (-check-input)

checkProperty.description: constraints or requirements evaluated at every stable state; one false at a state is a violation (-check-property)

checkStates.description: distinct states the search may visit; 0 is the engine's default (-check-states)

checkTimeout.description: seconds the search and each solver query may take; 0 is none (-check-timeout)

checkUnroll.description: loop iterations the symbolic engine unrolls; 0 is its default (-check-unroll)

checkWitness.description: carry each violation's and divergent value's witness file in the answer, for a replay schedule to follow (-check-witness)

engine.description: the engine asked: check (the default), smt, or one list_engines names

inputs.description: input parameter name to value, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

performerSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage, or a path from one, whose object performs the behavior; empty performs it outside any object

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

stateMachineSymbolId.description: qualified name of the state definition or usage to check; give this or actionSymbolId

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: check_behavior
